verdict.rationale: Warp publishes its own per-endpoint API reference (e.g., Get Company, List Bank Accounts, Create Benefit Deduction), along with quickstart code examples and an API definition for tooling and documentation-aware AI tools. None of the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples run in-browser, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or playground, runnable in-page examples, a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
